lessons: Choose a formation that maximizes work width while ensuring safety and minimizing reconfiguration time.
Maintain a consistent formation to reduce reconfiguration time and ensure efficient work.
Adjust the speed according to field conditions and formation to avoid compaction and maintain control.
Use the column formation for critical speed or tight spaces to minimize the number of machines on the ground.
Keep the offset minimal to avoid unnecessary gaps in the work and stay within the planned pass line.
Be flexible with the formation to adapt to changing field conditions and hazards.
